study.notes: 2016 conference abstract of the SCALE Obesity and Prediabetes 3 year results (liraglutide 3.0 mg once daily vs placebo, 2:1, adults with overweight or obesity and prediabetes, diet and exercise in both arms); n are randomised numbers (1505 vs 749), observed means with last observation carried forward; estimated treatment differences (ETD) with 95 percent CI at week 160; pct_weight_change -4.3 is the placebo corrected ETD (liraglutide -6.1 percent, placebo -1.9 percent); cardiometabolic risk factors were secondary objectives of the trial (prespecified TRUE); sponsor Novo Nordisk (phase 3 trial); trial registration not in the abstract (SCALE Obesity and Prediabetes is NCT01272219, stated in the 56 week and 3 year abstracts of study group 222; the 2016 abstract in this group does not give it); the group also holds an unrelated abstract (exenatide add on, medians only, no rows); extracted by the session (S), 2026-10-16

rows.notes: ETD printed as 29 percent [-34;-23], a reduction (sign from the interval), p<0.0001
ETD beats per minute at week 160 (mean pulse rate increased), p<0.0001; unfavourable direction

json.design: randomised, double blind, placebo controlled, 2:1, 3 years (160 weeks), phase 3, multicentre; plus an unrelated 2016 abstract in the same group (exenatide added to metformin and glibenclamide vs metformin and glibenclamide, 6 months, n 30 vs 15, medians with IQR and within group p only: no rows)
other_markers: time to onset of T2D hazard ratio 0.2

rob.justification: D1 low: randomised 2:1, double blind, phase 3 (sponsor randomisation); D2 some concerns: 3 year treatment with substantial discontinuation, analysis of observed means on treatment; D3 high: last observation carried forward with large attrition over 3 years and no multiple imputation reported in the abstract; D4 low: laboratory outcomes, blinded; D5 low: prespecified secondary objectives of a registered phase 3 trial

doubts: companion full paper needed (le Roux 2017 Lancet) for the 3 year attrition and analysis set
n per arm with data at week 160 not in the abstract (randomised numbers used)
the second abstract in the group (exenatide, medians) is a different trial, no rows
